description: Rank Ply registry components by a fuzzy or token match when the name is uncertain (for example "dialog modal"). Not a category browse: list_components filters by tier, category, or substring, and get_component reads one known name. Does not install. To copy a match into a project, tell the user to run npx ply-ui-cli add <name> (or local stdio add_components).

limit.description: Maximum ranked matches to return (1-40). Defaults to 12.

query.description: Natural-language or substring query (e.g. "dialog modal", "button"). Matches name, description, usage, and keywords.

name: search_components
title: Search Ply components
